test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence

The __child felt down__ from a great height.
solution:
The solution is **child fell down. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in "**The ****child felt down__**** from a great height**." is child fell down. 
 
• The child fell down from a great height.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Here the word in underlined segment ***felt ***is past tense of **feel **(sense of touch) and the correct answer is ***fell ***which is past tense of **fall **(make someone or something fall).
